newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends softer in listless trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends softer in listless trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar ended softer on Monday at C$1.3985 (US$0.7150) from this morning's open of C$1.3973 (US$0.7156) in thin afternoon trading, dealers said. * They said the currency is trapped in a narrow range without significant news to push it through support past C$1.4050 (US$0.7117) or challenge resistance at C$1.3940 (US$0.7173).
In domestic news, Ontario, Canada's most populous province and the country's main economic engine, said it will deliver its 1997/98 budget on May 6.
In February, the Ontario government revised its 1996/97 budget deficit to C$7.67 billion, down C$508 million from its original budget forecast.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar slid to 1.2123 marks from Friday's close of 1.2223 marks and eased to 89.60 yen from 89.87 yen.
